svg.title: For a fixed finite torus of side greater than one, let wQ,l(m) be order-lcoefficients of its regulated profile series; order zero tends to w0 Q as m →∞. At fixed finite formal horizon p, the polynomial cQ,p,m(t) = Pp l=0 tlwQ,l(m) is used only for numerical derivatives, without convergence of the full series. For sufficiently large m its base point, which tends to w0 Q, is in the PT6 neighborhood, so CQ(c(t), φ(c(t))) is identically the prescribed constant near zero. All positive derivatives vanish exactly and the zeroth one has that value. Another query has order-zero numerical reading
